question: airport closest to Maiduguri Nigeria, distance in km
sql: SELECT a.name AS airport, a.iata_code, a.icao_code, round(ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, a.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM populated_places p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, iata_code, icao_code, geometry FROM airports ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, geometry), name LIMIT 1) a ON true WHERE p.name = 'Maiduguri' AND p.country = 'Nigeria';

question: populated places within 150 km of Helsinki Vantaa airport, largest pop_max first
sql: SELECT p.name, p.admin1, p.country, p.pop_max, round(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, p.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM airports a JOIN populated_places p ON ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, p.geometry, 150000) WHERE a.iata_code = 'HEL' ORDER BY p.pop_max DESC, p.name;

question: world cities farthest from any major airport, worst served first
sql: SELECT p.name AS world_city, p.country, a.name AS nearest_major_airport, a.iata_code, round(ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, a.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM populated_places p JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, iata_code, geometry FROM airports WHERE type = 'major' ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, geometry), name LIMIT 1) a ON true WHERE p.is_world_city ORDER BY dist_km DESC, p.name;

question: 5 nearest national capitals to Abu Dhabi, exclude Abu Dhabi itself
sql: SELECT p2.name AS capital, p2.country, round(ST_Distance_Sphere(p1.geometry, p2.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM populated_places p1 JOIN LATERAL (SELECT name, country, geometry FROM populated_places WHERE feature_class = 'Admin-0 capital' AND name <> p1.name ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(p1.geometry, geometry), name LIMIT 5) p2 ON true WHERE p1.name = 'Abu Dhabi' AND p1.feature_class = 'Admin-0 capital' ORDER BY dist_km, p2.name;

question: cities over 500k within 200 km of Vadodara airport
sql: SELECT p.name, p.country, p.pop_max, round(ST_Distance_Sphere(a.geometry, p.geometry) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM airports a JOIN populated_places p ON ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, p.geometry, 200000) WHERE a.iata_code = 'BDQ' AND p.pop_max > 500000 ORDER BY dist_km, p.name;

question: 3 airports closest to Kirov Russia, distances via UTM 39N transform
sql: WITH k AS (SELECT geometry FROM populated_places WHERE name = 'Kirov' AND country = 'Russia') SELECT a.name AS airport, a.icao_code, round(ST_Distance(ST_Transform((SELECT geometry FROM k), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32639', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(a.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:32639', always_xy := true)) / 1000.0, 1) AS dist_km FROM airports a ORDER BY dist_km, a.name LIMIT 3;
